items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Jim Self on tuba the other day.

ctx.x: Jim Self on tuba the other day. And speaking of studios, I guess everyone has heard of Mort Stephens. He's the guy who did the theme song for Hawaii Five-O and Police Woman and several other shows. Anyhow, business has been rather slow around town, I hear. And I got a call from Dateline(?) just last night. He's got a new TV film coming up, and him being one of the loyal people, naturally he calls me.
